claim: For the standard \(n\)-state Černý automaton \(C_n\), let \(\lambda_n(s)\) be the minimum length of a word whose image has size at most \(n-s\). For every \(n\ge 3\) and \(1\le s\le \lceil n/2ceil\), one has \(\lambda_n(s)=3s-2\).
integrity: The all-parameter theorem is proved by a direct rank-drop counting argument and an explicit witness. A standalone breadth-first verifier checks all admissible cases for \(3\le n\le12\) without being used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The exact formula is established only for deficiency \(s\le\lceil n/2\rceil\); the later rank-collapse profile is not classified. Historical originality remains subject to the residual risk of an older equivalent subset-reachability formulation not surfaced by the inspected indexes.
title: Exact early deficiency profile of the Černý automata
